_scope: Merge Serp Results and Filter New URLs (whole-code replacements, every other line kept), two new IF nodes, Nothing To Enrich? and Phase 2 Found Nothing?, and the removal of Limit Candidates, which never capped anything (its maxItems expression resolves to undefined); Nothing To Enrich?[1] feeds Split In Batches directly. No other node changes. Filter New URLs also carries header-comment corrections (removedLines) so its figures match the retained executions.
_why: n8n runs nothing after an empty list. When every profile of a phase is dropped before enrichment (all already fetched, all on a foreign LinkedIn subdomain, no /in/ link, or a phase 2 with no organic result) the execution ends "success" with no completion: the search record stays `submitted` and the page spins until its 10-minute timeout. Exec 2057 (pinned smoke test) shows the stall on the live engine. In the 14 retained real runs (1913-2048) it happened 0 times; the frequency figures from the generated searches in the test are synthetic, not a production rate.
_expectedEffect: A run whose candidate list is non-empty is unchanged: the same sends, SerpAPI and EnrichLayer calls and static data, and the same node runs except that Nothing To Enrich? runs where the pass-through Limit Candidates ran, and Phase 2 Found Nothing? runs on the existing Merge Serp Results / All Serp Pages Failed? close paths (proven on the 2048 replay and on generated searches). An empty phase 2 closes once through Finalize Phase 2 Send with the phase-1 totals; an empty phase 1 closes once with a "No candidates found" completion. Nothing more is paid for. Removing Limit Candidates changes nothing: in production 27 of 27 saved Limit runs (1913-2048) and exec 2057 passed every item on (its maxItems expression renders undefined), and even if expressions could read static data, Filter New URLs already caps at the same values (the tier maxEnrich in phase 1, hhPhase2 maxEnrich in phase 2).

* profiles for 37 distinct people, and 24 of the 46 were people living outside
* Iraq who the location filter then threw away. Two defects, both fixed here:
*    measured profiles LinkedIn had renamed the profile, so the returned id no
*    longer matches what Google hands us next time — one of those was a paid

*    measured foreign every time: 11 of 11 in exec 2039 and 22 of 22 across execs
*    2035/2036, with no Iraqi among them. Those are now dropped before enrichment.
*    Kept: `www.` (carries no country signal — 12 Americans came that way, a query
*    problem, not a URL one), `iq.`, and `sy.` — twice a `sy.` profile turned out
*    to be living in Erbil, Iraq, so Syria's code is not trusted as proof.
* The built-in `Limit Candidates` node that follows has never cut anything: its
* maxItems expression calls $getWorkflowStaticData, which exists only inside
* Code nodes, not in n8n expressions, so it resolves to undefined and the limit
* keeps every item - 27 of 27 retained Limit runs passed their input through
* unchanged, up to 45 profiles in a phase 2 whose recorded cap was 20 or 40.
* So the caps live here, where static data can be read:
*     (20 for Tier 20, 40 for Tier 40) - set since 2026-09-17, applied only now.
* a Person Search link (use_cache=if-present, per EnrichLayer's docs), 2 for any other
* (if-recent). Phase 1 stops taking a profile that would leave less than 2 credits, so
* phase 2 can always send at least one: an empty list here would end the search with no
* completion. Phase 2 takes what the rest pays for. The record counts one request per
